t: This is the statue of Sir Colin Campbell, Lord Clyde, on Waterloo Place. It's Grade Two listed, designed by Carlo Marochetti and erected in 1867. Campbell was a Field Marshal who served in the Peninsular War and commanded the Highland Brigade at the Alma. At Balaclava his thin red line of Highlanders repulsed the Russian attack. During the Indian Mutiny he became Commander-in-Chief, India, and relieved Lucknow. Marochetti, an Italian-born sculptor, settled in England in 1848 and received commissions from Queen Victoria.
